title: Decoupled Single-Mask Annotation Noise Detection via Cross-Sectional Patch Self-consistency
mechanism: Training-free label-noise score: sample cross-sectional patches along a thin structure, retrieve intensity-matched neighbour patches by vector search, and score noise by mask disagreement among neighbours.
adaptation: Sample patches orthogonal to crack skeletons; retrieve similar intensity profiles from other cells and sources; flag cells where the label line is off the dark ridge compared with peers; aggregate into per-source offset and width estimates.
min_experiment: Arm: compute noise scores for train crack labels; retrain house with the top 5% patches set to ignore. Baseline: house. Metrics: correlation with the audit flags; test crack IoU and relF1@2. Kill: no enrichment of audited cells in the top decile, or crack IoU change under 0.012.
evidence: R (web summary of abstract): on coronary CT, transverse and oblique vessels had 5.1x higher error rates than axis-aligned ones; no multi-rater labels or network training needed; code stated but URL not verified.
prior_overlap: none for this mechanism. D16 / D17 cover label refinement and annotator style with other methods.
